# Jui-Hong Chien

> Biomedical engineer and neuroscience researcher (Ph.D., University of Florida, 2011). EEG analysis: epileptic seizure detection and prediction, human electrophysiology of pain and conditioned fear, and functional neuroimaging of power distance and social decisions.

Also written: Jui-Hong Chien, J. H. Chien.

## Profiles
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=F9vlBhoAAAAJ): full publication list
- [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Jui-Hong-Chien)
- [CV site](https://sites.google.com/view/jui-hong-chien-cv/home)

## Key work
- [Personal socio-cultural preferences modulate neural correlates of decisions to socialize with powerful persons](https://doi.org/10.1002/hbm.25963): first author, Human Brain Mapping 43(14), 2022
- [Behavioral, physiological and EEG activities associated with conditioned fear](https://doi.org/10.3390/s20236751): first author, Sensors 2020
- [Oscillatory EEG activity during fear conditioning](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroscience.2016.12.047): first author, Neuroscience 2017
- [Painful laser stimuli and event-related oscillatory EEG](https://doi.org/10.1152/jn.00209.2014): first author, J Neurophysiol 2014
- [Signal regularity-based seizure prediction](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10559-011-9339-x): first author, Cybernetics and Systems Analysis 2011
- US Patents 10,849,563 (brain function analysis) and 10,478,116 (feeding readiness diagnosis)

# Jui-Hong Chien, Ph.D.

> Biomedical engineer and neuroscience researcher working on EEG analysis: seizure detection and prediction, human electrophysiology of pain and conditioned fear, and functional neuroimaging of socio-cultural decision-making.
